passages.context: No. 7701 is labeled Communion Paten and described as round, 7 3/4 inches in diameter, metal gold-plated, with a wood handle. No. 7702 is likewise labeled Communion Paten and described as round, 7 inches in diameter and 9 1/2 inches with handles, metal gold-plated. The page image visibly distinguishes a one-handle form from a two-handle form. These are 1952 commercial exemplars, not liturgical norms; they do not establish an exact rim height, depth, decorative requirement, color requirement, or universal material.
